groups.note: Actual until with a relative sets the time limit. The Russian construction не … как expresses the corresponding temporal limit.

unmappedSource.reason: These printed articles have no separately expressed determiner in the corresponding Russian constructions.

unmappedTarget.reason: Printed TR writes the reply addressee. Actual has no separate addressee at this point.
